name: software-team
description: 软件开发团队：按风险编排需求、设计、实现、审查与 QA；提供快速模式、BugFix、整改、标准开发和上线前审查。PR 粒度与模板遵循目标仓库规范；依赖/API 升级时评估上游能力与下游简化机会。

description_i18n.en: Software team orchestrated by risk-based workflows for planning, implementation, review and QA. Supports fast delivery, bug fixes, remediation, standard development and release review. PR scope and templates follow repository conventions; dependency/API upgrades assess upstream capabilities and downstream simplification.
